The Crimson Sparks — Album 1: The First Spark

Close

"You passed a street I left behind"

Verse 1

You passed a street I left behind Three minutes late, same state of mind You grabbed the coffee I almost chose Your name unknown, but somehow close I took the seat you nearly took We read the same line in different books A hundred moments misaligned Two parallel yet drifting lives

Pre-Chorus Every turn, every door Every chance we just miss more Like a shadow just out of touch I feel the shape, yet it’s not enough

Chorus We’re so close, so far Like two stars that almost are In the same sky, same night But never in the same line of light

Every step, every scar Points me to where you are But fate keeps drawing lines apart So close… so far

Verse 2 You hear a song I used to love It hits your heart but don’t know why I pass you by in crowded rooms A second glance, then both goodbye You laugh with friends I’ve never met I cry for reasons you’d understand Somewhere between your world and mine There’s just a thread… we never find

Pre-Chorus Every train, every flight Every almost in the night Like a dream I can’t break through I keep chasing you

Chorus We’re so close, so far Like two stars that almost are In the same sky, same night But never in the same line of light Every step, every scar Points me to where you are But fate keeps drawing lines apart So close… so far

Bridge What if we met on a different day? What if one choice had changed the way? Would your eyes have felt like home to me? Or is this how it’s meant to be? Maybe we’re written in between Not in the pages, just unseen Two hearts in perfect harmony Out of reach, eternally

Breakdown (soft) I swear I’ve felt you next to me… In every “almost” memory…

Final Chorus We’re so close, so far Like a wish I can’t restart In another life, another time Maybe your hand would fit in mine Every road, every scar Still whispers who you are But we’re just echoes in the dark So close… so far

Outro And if our worlds never collide I’ll still believe we were aligned Just two souls meant to be …almost eventually
